mapper.select: SELECT c.company_id, c.company_code, c.trial_email AS email, c.email_verified_at, a.user_account_id, e.employee_no FROM company c JOIN user_account a ON a.company_id = c.company_id AND a.role_code = 'ROLE_ADMIN' JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = c.company_id AND e.employee_id = a.employee_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY a.user_account_id FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_EMAIL_VERIFICATION.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO email_verification (email_verification_id, company_id, user_account_id, purpose_code, email, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{v.emailVerificationId}, #{v.companyId}, #{v.userAccountId}, #{purpose}, #{v.email}, #{v.tokenHash}, #{v.issuedAt}, #{v.expiresAt})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO email_rate_limit t USING (SELECT #{companyId} AS company_id, #{email} AS email, #{purpose} AS purpose_code, #{today} AS quota_date FROM dual) s ON (t.company_id = s.company_id AND t.email = s.email AND t.purpose_code = s.purpose_code AND t.quota_date = s.quota_date) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.sent_count = t.sent_count + #{resends}, t.last_sent_at = #{now}, t.updated_at = #{now} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (company_id, email, purpose_code, quota_date, sent_count, last_sent_at) VALUES (s.company_id, s.email, s.purpose_code, s.quota_date, #{resends}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT email_verification_id, company_id, user_account_id, email, token_hash, issued_at, expires_at, consumed_at, revoked_at FROM email_verification WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND purpose_code = #{purpose}
